scope.purpose: Rank evidence-bounded hypotheses for the failed Minecart PCQN qualification and prepare a supervisor decision package.

methods: Read-only audit of frozen protocol, PCQN/replay/action-selection code, source audits, diagnosis artifacts, v1/v2 qualification artifacts, and existing validation JSON.
Read-only extraction of Pareto archive points from existing safe PyTorch checkpoints with weights_only=True; no environment was instantiated or stepped.
Read-only cross-check against five already-registered full-text primary-paper notes; no literature-discovery workflow was restarted.

Two on-demand Codex workers gathered code/evidence and literature entries; the coordinator alone synthesized and wrote this artifact. Same-family findings remain evidence gathering, not independent scientific acceptance.

offline_archive_extraction.interpretation_limit: The archive is cumulative historical evidence of exploratory returns. It does not prove that the corresponding transitions remain in replay or that the current greedy policy retains the behavior.

evidence_to_hypothesis.evidence: Positive ore returns occur in training archives for every primary run and every v2 seed; the same frozen reward scale is used for training and validation.
evidence_to_hypothesis.caveat: Consistent scaling is not proof that the scale is optimal for learning.

evidence_to_hypothesis.evidence: Uniform, matched-random, and full adaptive arms all produced zero greedy validation ore over five paired primary seeds.
evidence_to_hypothesis.caveat: This does not rule out every future allocation method.

evidence_to_hypothesis.evidence: Shapes and mappings are explicit and tested; preference is concatenated to state; Mine is action 0 so deterministic argmax tie-breaking does not suppress it; termination and truncation are stored separately.
evidence_to_hypothesis.caveat: Code audit and invariant tests cannot exclude all function-approximation or unobserved implementation defects.

evidence_to_hypothesis.evidence: Neither ensemble mean nor individual heads selected Mine in 345417 primary-probe action decisions.
evidence_to_hypothesis.caveat: No equivalent head-specific behavior probe was run for v2.

evidence_to_hypothesis.evidence: Exploratory training archives contain positive ore trajectories in all audited primary and v2 seeds.
evidence_to_hypothesis.caveat: Archive presence does not imply the greedy learner acquired or retained the behavior.

evidence_to_hypothesis.evidence: V1 showed within-seed acquisition followed by loss, but exact proportional one-step TD-error PER in v2 still yielded zero greedy ore at all 30 checkpoints.
evidence_to_hypothesis.caveat: V2 was not a paired-seed causal comparison and does not falsify all trajectory-aware retention mechanisms.

evidence_to_hypothesis.evidence: Ore requires a multi-stage delayed sequence while fuel cost is immediate; successful exploratory trajectories repeatedly fail to become stable greedy behavior; current PCQN uses one-step Double-DQN targets and v1/v2 Uniform-PCQN updates each transition under its behavior preference; TD-error PER alone was insufficient.
evidence_to_hypothesis.caveat: No n-step, return-conditioned, envelope, or achieved-return preference-relabeling intervention has been executed under this study.

candidate_solutions.name: Trajectory-aware hindsight or diverse preference replay
candidate_solutions.code_gap: The completed Uniform-PCQN remediations update each sample under its stored behavior preference. Existing adaptive resampling is not achieved-return hindsight relabeling and v2 priority is not trajectory-aware.
candidate_solutions.tradeoffs: Smallest conceptual change, but requires storing trajectory outcome or return-to-go and strictly matching update budget. It can reuse successful experience but does not guarantee exploration or solve delayed credit by itself.
candidate_solutions.authority: Requires a versioned scope/protocol amendment and supervisor approval before any implementation or training.

candidate_solutions.name: Envelope value updates as a replacement Minecart backbone
candidate_solutions.code_gap: Current targets maximize action only under the supplied preference; they do not maximize over candidate value vectors/preferences or use the envelope loss.
candidate_solutions.tradeoffs: Closest discrete value-based literature mechanism for cross-preference alignment, but it is a major backbone change, not a v3 hyperparameter tweak. Existing 200-step smoke proves runtime only, not Minecart performance.
candidate_solutions.authority: Requires a new study design, fairness qualification, supervisor approval, and fresh training authorization.

candidate_solutions.name: Return-and-horizon conditioned trajectory archive
candidate_solutions.code_gap: The repository ParetoArchive stores return vectors and metadata, not trajectories or return-to-go targets, so it cannot train a PCN-style supervised policy from rare successful episodes.
candidate_solutions.tradeoffs: Directly targets retention of successful trajectories and avoids moving TD targets, but needs new trajectory logging and a different model/training objective. It is the largest departure and still depends on obtaining successful trajectories.
candidate_solutions.authority: Requires a broad scope amendment and supervisor approval.

recommended_decision.current_scope: Preserve the failed result, do not run v3, and use this memo to decide between a bounded trajectory-aware preference-replay amendment and reporting the blocked negative result.
recommended_decision.preferred_if_amendment_is_authorized: Test trajectory-aware achieved-return preference relabeling first because it addresses the clearest code gap while preserving the existing conditioned value model more than Envelope or PCN.
do_not_repeat: Additional interactions without a mechanism-specific falsification gate
Final-test or checkpoint locking before a revised qualified study completes

preconditions: Supervisor approves a versioned scope amendment.
A new plan freezes interactions, updates, replay/relabel count, checkpoints, validation budget, seeds, and no-final-test firewall before execution.
Successful-trajectory and replay-sampling counters are logged without changing rewards or using test data.
gates: Acquisition: each seed records whether ore-delivery transitions exist and how often they are sampled/relabelled.
Expression: greedy validation records Mine, cargo, delivery, and positive ore per preference at every predeclared checkpoint.
Retention: after a seed first passes the ore criterion, it must retain the criterion for at least two subsequent predeclared checkpoints; a single selected spike is insufficient.

Mechanism falsifier: if relabeling materially increases exposure to successful trajectories but all seeds still have zero greedy ore and no Mine-action margin improvement, reject preference-replay insufficiency as the primary remedy and stop rather than stack more changes.
